observation: Page background is pure white in A but a warm cream in B for the hero and book sections.

observation: B introduces a green brand palette (dark green CTAs, green links, green author names); A uses yellow CTA buttons and black/dark-navy text with underlined black links.

observation: Headings in A are extra-heavy, tightly set display type; B headings are semibold/bold Inter, visibly lighter and less condensed.
evidence: Screenshots: A 'One place, not all over the place.' and 'We literally wrote the book...' appear very bold and tight; B equivalents appear lighter weight.

observation: Page is nearly twice as tall in A (6474px) as in B (3492px) because of larger type, stacked testimonials and generous whitespace; B compresses via side-by-side columns and grid.
evidence: pageHeight A 6474, B 3492.

observation: A's 'One place' section is a single centered column with the product screenshot full-width above the text; B places the screenshot on the left and copy on the right in a two-column split.
evidence: A screenshot: screenshot at y~220-570 above centered heading at y~590. B screenshot: image at left x~120-375, heading and paragraphs at right x~425-730.

observation: The 'We literally wrote the book' section is centered with the book cover left-aligned below the heading in A, while B uses a clean two-column row with the cover left and heading plus copy right, and tilted cover with shadow.
evidence: A: heading centered at y~800, cover at x~90-160 beneath; B: cover at x~125-285 with drop shadow, heading to its right at y~830.

observation: Testimonials are a single-column stack of large centered pull quotes in A; B renders them as a three-column masonry of white cards.
evidence: A screenshot: 10 quotes at large bold type centered one per row from y~1050-1970 (display). B screenshot: cards in three columns at x~95-730, y~1240-1620.

observation: Quote cards in B have white fill, rounded corners and subtle shadow on a sage-green band; A quotes have no containers.
evidence: B screenshot: rounded white cards on grey-green section background; A screenshot: plain text on white.

observation: Testimonial attribution style differs: A uses small italic dash-prefixed text under the quote in dark ('-Tobi Lütke, CEO, Shopify'); B uses bold green text with an em dash ('— Tobi Lütke, CEO, Shopify').
evidence: A screenshot attribution lines are small and grey-black without space after hyphen; B screenshot green bold names with '— '.

observation: Quote text size is far larger in A (headline-sized, bold) than in B (small regular body text), reversing the emphasis of social proof.
evidence: A screenshot: quotes in bold ~30px display; B screenshot: card quotes at body size in regular weight.

evidence: original_dom tags blockquote 10, cite 10; framework_dom tags figure 10, blockquote 10, figcaption 10 (no cite key).

observation: B's section background bands alternate (cream, white, cream, sage green, white, dark green) to separate sections; A uses mostly white with a hand-drawn squiggle divider and a beige wavy blob under the hero.
